manually. These instructions provide a high level overview of the file upload process for Page 3
GEER I - LEAs, Page 4 GEER I - IHEs, Page 5 GEER I - Other Entities, Page 6 GEER II - LEAs, Page
7 GEER II - IHEs, and Page 8 GEER II - Other Entities.
